rows.en: Wing Zero!! Why are you here!?
Wing Zero!! Why are you here!?
The Zero System inside me predicted that Epyon would appear.
Epyon!! Right now, you've been consumed by the Zero System!
This is what it means to master the Zero System!!
He's predicting Epyon's attacks perfectly... So this is the true power of the Zero System...
Epyon! Is this the kind of battle you were seeking!?
No use, huh... You're completely consumed. No choice, then. I'll... take you down!!
Epyon!! Right now, you've been consumed by the Zero System!
This is what it means to master the Zero System!!
He's predicting Epyon's attacks perfectly... So this is the true power of the Zero System...
Epyon! Is this the kind of battle you were seeking!?
It's no use... You're completely consumed. No choice, then. I'll take you down!!
Looks like the Zero System has shut down...
By rights, you should have been our comrade too.
But once this world swallowed you up, they used you, Zero System and all,
Epyon left without saying another word.
There's no time! We're going to stop the Libra Cannon! Let's hurry!!
Whoa, no time to stand around spacing out. We're going to stop the Libra Cannon! Let's hurry!!
...We can't just stand here! We're going to stop the Libra Cannon! Let's hurry!!
...That's right, we have to go stop the Libra Cannon! There's no time! Let's hurry!!
There's no time! We're going to stop the Libra Cannon!
There's no time! Let's go stop the Libra Cannon!
There's no time! We're going to stop the Libra Cannon!
There's no time! We're going to stop the Libra Cannon!
There's no time! We're going to stop the Libra Cannon!!
There's no time! We must go stop the Libra Cannon!
There's no time! We're going to stop the Libra Cannon! Move it!!
We ain't got time! We're gonna go stop the Libra Cannon!
There's no time! We've gotta stop the Libra Cannon!! Let's hurry!!
Come on, let's hurry and go stop the Libra Cannon!! We don't have any time!!
This is it! The Libra Cannon's control room!! What's the energy charge at?
Please, take a look. It's over 80%!

notes.note: Speaker labels in this slice are shifted one row by the extractor; per 0649.bla, row 0.n = MessWinSet +n. #0.71-84 and #0.86-99 are 14 leader variants (k=0..13) on the chain 10,6,8,7,5,4,3,2,1,15,14,13,12,11 = 00, Nu, God, Zeta, OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman (Wing Zero excluded: he arrives here). #0.83-84 = Seven, Ultraman. Source ends a question with !!, rendered !?.
k=6 Den-O (Momotaros), rough variant. #0.96 (k=10 Mebius) is the polite form; kept as the shared English since the wording otherwise matches.

Script: #0.100 Epyon silent; #0.101 Wing Zero. #0.102-115 alternate Wing Zero (even: 102,104,106,109,111,113,115) and Epyon (silences), except #0.108 = Ankh (observer, per script). Slice labels here are off by one and were ignored.
Ankh watching the duel; 'He' = Wing Zero doing the predicting (g=m).
'Chigau hazu da' answers his own question in #0.109: that can't be the battle Epyon wanted.
'Dame ka' -> 'No use, huh'; 'nomareru' rendered 'consumed' consistently with #0.102.

#0.122-134 are not referenced by 0649.bla (script jumps from 115 to 140): an unused duplicate of #0.70 and #0.102-113. Translated identically; #0.122 mirrors the reply to 'Is this the Zero System's power!?' (#0.70, in story_129) - keep in sync with that row. #0.134 differs slightly from #0.113 (no 'ka', no pause before 'defeat').
Sentence runs across #0.144-145; cut at the matching point. 'Yatsura' = Regis; 'this world' = the Gaia Cube world.

Post-battle leader block uses a different chain: 6,4,11,1,7,5,12,10,2,13,8,3,15,14 = Nu, W, Ultraman, Rider 1, Zeta, OOO, Seven, 00, RX, Taro, God, Den-O, Zero, Mebius (#0.150-163). Wording matches each voice (W casual #151, God #160, Momotaros #161, Zero #162, Mebius polite #163).

0650.bla: #0.1 Ankh; #0.2-16 leader variants on chain 9,6,4,11,1,7,5,12,10,2,13,8,3,15,14 = Wing Zero, Nu, W, Ultraman, Rider 1, Zeta, OOO, Seven, 00, RX, Taro, God, Den-O, Zero, Mebius. This slice holds k=0..9.
k=6 OOO: polite request form kept as 'Please, take a look'.

report: 80/80. Extractor speaker labels shifted one row in 0649 (ignored; speakers from 0649.bla). #0.122-134 unused duplicate block (not referenced by script). #0.122 should match story_129 #0.70. No new names or terms.
